verdict.rationale: GitLab documents personal access tokens and supports HTTP Bearer or OAuth 2.0 authentication for its REST API, so an agent can be given its own API credential. The pack never shows that these tokens can be scoped or limited to specific projects or permissions. Allow/Ask/Deny tool policies for agents add some least-privilege control, but at the tool layer rather than through the credential itself. Missing for 10: evidence of token scopes, project/group access tokens or service accounts for agents, expiry/rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
